text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if it isn't Her Majesty Pocket! I<n>trust you are in
good health.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I am greatly honored to be here on<n>this fine day in
your stunning<n>presence.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
May Your Majesty shine ever more<n>brightly, and
may your glory dazzle<n>with radiance.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, pump the brakes with the<n>polite stuff!
What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You feeling okay? I don't get why<n>you're all weird
today—hm? What day<n>is it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, it was all a surprise to let<n>you bask in royal
glory. Happy<n>birthday!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, Your Majesty, I shall have the<n>attendants
bring your celebratory gifts<n>forthwith. Should you
need anything, I<n>await your call.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Pft... Hahaha! Just wow! You're the<n>best at this,
Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I appreciate it! Anything at all,<n>right? I
won't hold back!
